
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# This child template expects the following variables in the environment:
# - sig_data: List from compute_signature_data()
# - All the data frames/catalogs needed for plotting

cat(generate_section_header(sig_data))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 19
#| fig-height: 3

# ID89 plots: signature and catalog
id89_plots <- create_id89_plots(
  sig_data,
  to.plot.all.ID89.signatures.final,
  to.plot.all.ID89.catalogs,
  plot89_height
)

gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  id89_plots$p1,
  id89_plots$p2,
  nrow = 1,
  ncol = 2,
  heights = plot89_height
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 19
#| fig-height: 3
#| eval: !expr '!sig_data$is_insdel15_16'

# Decomposition plots (only for non-InsDel15/16)
if (!is.null(id89_plots$p3)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    id89_plots$p3,
    id89_plots$p4,
    nrow = 1,
    ncol = 2,
    heights = plot89_height
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# 476-type section header
if (sig_data$has_476_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<p><strong>Cosine similarity between 476-type signature and the exemplar:</strong> ',
    '<span class="cosine-value">',
    sig_data$cosine476,
    '</span></p>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    '476-Type ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    ' was not found by de novo extraction. ',
    'This is the 476-Type spectrum of ',
    sig_data$catalog,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 19
#| fig-height: 4

# ID476 plots
id476_plots <- create_id476_plots(
  sig_data,
  final.Koh476.signatures,
  to.plot.all.ID476.catalogs,
  plot476_base_size,
  plto476_simplify_labels
)

if (!is.null(id476_plots$p5)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    id476_plots$p5,
    nrow = 1,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = plot476_height
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 19
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr 'sig_data$has_476_signature'

# Second 476 plot (catalog) - only if signature exists
if (!is.null(id476_plots$p6)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    id476_plots$p6,
    nrow = 1,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = plot476_height
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (sig_data$has_83_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="subsection-header">',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    ' corresponds to the 83-type signature <strong>',
    sig_data$ID83signature,
    '</strong>',
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    'No corresponding 83-type signature found for ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr 'sig_data$has_83_signature'

# ID83 signature plot (only if signature exists)
ICAMS::PlotCatalog(to.plot.all.signatures.final[,
  sig_data$ID83signature,
  drop = FALSE
])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr 'sig_data$has_83_signature'

cat(paste0(
  '\n\n<p><strong>Cosine similarity between the 83-type signature and the exemplar:</strong> ',
  '<span class="cosine-value">',
  sig_data$cosine83,
  '</span></p>\n\n'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Header for exemplar 83-type spectrum
cat(paste0(
  '\n\n<p><strong>83-type spectrum of the exemplar ',
  sig_data$catalog,
  ':</strong></p>\n\n'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

# ID83 exemplar spectrum (always shown)
if (sig_data$is_polyT_removed) {
  ICAMS::PlotCatalog(to.plot.WGS_PCAWG_HMF_indels.catalog.no.polyT[,
    sig_data$catalog,
    drop = FALSE
  ])
} else {
  ICAMS::PlotCatalog(to.plot.WGS_PCAWG_HMF_indels.catalog[,
    sig_data$catalog,
    drop = FALSE
  ])
}
```
